title: IGAR Paper 1: Weak-Label Disagreement and Transformer Supervision-Source Sensitivity — Reproducibility Package
description: Reproducibility materials for the study "Characterizing Weak-Label Disagreement in Indonesian Digital Public-Service Application Reviews: Transformer Sensitivity to Supervision-Source Choice". The study characterizes naturally occurring disagreement between rating-derived and translation-mediated VADER weak sentiment supervision and evaluates downstream Transformer sensitivity using a paired supervision-source design. The IGAR dataset is not redistributed in this package; it is publicly available from Mendeley Data, Version 3, DOI 10.17632/7zryc6k76z.3.
